video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.16.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on his two-way relationship with Darius Garland
quotes.excerpt: he is not afraid to pick up the phone and call me.
quotes.quote: It is almost like a two-way street with him. He is not afraid to pick up the phone and call me. Not even text, he will actually call me. So we have that kind of relationship. Sometimes you tell Darius something, but he wants to be assured. He will call up and say, 'Hey, how you doing? Tell me again my role next year. What do you want from me next year?' I think sometimes a young player needs reassurance.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he and Darius Garland have a unique two-way relationship where Garland is not afraid to call him directly to ask for reassurance about his role. Atkinson notes that sometimes a young player just needs that extra support.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on coaching Darius Garland to be less perfect
quotes.excerpt: he wants to be perfect. He is almost nervous about or has anxiety about being too perfect.
quotes.quote: I think I probably change a little. I definitely err on the side of being more positive because he wants to be perfect. He is almost nervous about or has anxiety about being too perfect. So I think our communication has changed a lot more to focusing on the positive. Early on in our relationship, it was like, 'Why didn't you pull over? Why weren't you there being the low man on this one?' I am realizing that the more I coach him, the more I can really teach with the positive.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he has shifted his coaching style with Darius Garland to focus more on the positive because Garland has anxiety about being too perfect. Atkinson believes this approach is more effective for his development.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the benefits of the new Cavaliers facility
quotes.excerpt: it is a great recruiting tool for players, staff.
quotes.quote: First of all, it is a great recruiting tool for players, staff. And the fact that everything is going to be downtown, I think that is really cool. And when you have those kind of resources at your fingertips, we are going to have a shooting lab. I just can't wait to get in there to play with all the fancy stuff and figure it out. It is such a positive for the organization.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson is excited about the new Cavaliers facility calling it a great recruiting tool and noting he cannot wait to use the new shooting lab to help the organization.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the Donovan Mitchell and Jarrett Allen guard-big pairing
quotes.excerpt: Donovan is good with that. Donovan can play with me as the center, obviously.
quotes.quote: Donovan is good with that. Donovan can play with me as the center, obviously. I don't think he has that much of a preference. But what I have liked about it is I feel like James and Evan have bonded over this a little bit. I see them talking more on the court, talking more off the court. And I think that raises our ceiling, quite honestly. Donovan is comfortable playing with either.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says Donovan Mitchell is comfortable playing with any center pairing and believes the bond forming between James and Evan Mobley will raise the ceiling for the Cavaliers this season.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley's development with James
quotes.excerpt: Evan is already good in the pocket, just more like screening angles and flipping screens.
quotes.quote: Evan is already good in the pocket, just more like screening angles and flipping screens. All the nuances of the pick and roll, James is a master at teaching it and manipulating it. So the more they are together, I feel like the better they are going to be. Just again, kind of using James as a knowledge base to influence Evan's productivity. And Evan is smart too, right? They go back and forth. It is not a one-way street.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson is leaning on James to help mentor Evan Mobley on the nuances of the pick and roll. Atkinson says the two are constantly exchanging knowledge to improve Mobley's productivity.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley's defensive recognition
quotes.excerpt: Evan is nowhere to be found.
quotes.quote: It is interesting with Evan. He was defensive player of the year a couple years ago, and the GM survey comes out and they have all these different categories for best defensive player, like best perimeter defender, best defensive center, best rim protector, that kind of stuff. And Evan is nowhere to be found. That is why maybe why I didn't read that thing. I would get riled up because he should be.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he refuses to read the GM survey because Evan Mobley was left off the defensive player lists. Atkinson believes Mobley should be recognized as one of the best defenders in the league.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the growth of his relationship with Craig Porter Jr.
quotes.excerpt: our relationship has grown. My understanding of his game.
quotes.quote: Our relationship has grown. My understanding of his game. And I think it was helped by maybe even Kobe and Weems and Gansey just trying to explain to me what type of player he is and who he is. And before he got here, he won games. And our staff just pushing me, like, 'Man, this guy has got a lot of unique characteristics.' And I don't know when it switched, but I am going to embrace this. I would say this, he is going to be in the rotation. He is going to help us win games.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson confirms that Craig Porter Jr. will be in the rotation this season. Atkinson says he has come to embrace the unique characteristics of Porter Jr. and believes he is going to help the team win games.
